description: Screenshot of a verified tweet by Ryan Saavedra (@RealSaavedra), posted 9:54 PM 7/24/19, reporting that Jeffrey Epstein was found injured in his New York City jail cell after a possible suicide attempt or assault. The tweet embeds an nbcnewyork.com link card headlined 'Epstein Found Injured on Floor of NYC Jail Cell: Sources' with a well-known photograph of Epstein in a dark polo shirt seated beside a purple tufted chair.

description: Dark-theme screenshot of Q drop 3429 (tripcode !!mG7VJxZNCI, 15 Jul 2019), as rendered by a Q-drop aggregator app, titled with the question of whether the Manhattan power outage was an attempt to 'takeout' Jeffrey Epstein. The drop poses rhetorical questions about eliminating a liability, where Epstein is held, coincidences, and 'POWERful people connected', ending with 'PANIC.' It links the July 13 2019 Manhattan blackout to Epstein's detention without evidence.
text: 3429. Was the Manhattan Power Outage an Attempt to Takeout Epstein?. Q !!mG7VJxZNCI 15 Jul 2019 - 5:47:53 AM. How do you eliminate a LIABILITY?. Where is EPSTEIN being held?. Reconcile. Do you believe in coincidences?. POWERful people connected?. PANIC. Q
flags: The drop's implied link between the Manhattan blackout and Epstein is an unverified claim; officials attributed the July 13 2019 outage to equipment failure

description: Photograph, apparently a still shot taken through a window or from drone footage, of a room interior with a bare, stained mattress set on a dark platform beneath a large sliding glass window that looks directly out over open water. Metal scaffolding poles stand in the right foreground, and crumpled white sheeting or plastic lies at the head of the mattress, giving the room an under-renovation or abandoned look. In the context of Q drop 3493 (July 2019) this image circulated as showing the interior of a building on Jeffrey Epstein's Little St. James Island, imagery widely attributed to drone footage of the island; the location is not identifiable from the image itself.
flags: Location claim (interior on Epstein's island) comes from the drop's context and circulation, not from anything visible in the image — unverified
